messages.author: 00ebeb6e0521112d
messages.subject: RE: [unmarked] Training/learning opportunities?
parts:
Dear Fabiola,

yes, we always announce our own stuff on the Phidot website which Andy gave. Darryl MacKenzie also always seems to announce his occupancy workshops there, so this is a good place to watch from time to time.

Not sure where you are based, but my colleagues Gurutzeta Guillera Arroita, Jose Lahoz Monfort and I will teach a week-long occupancy workshop in Mallorca/Spain, in early January (11-15; see here http://www.phidot.org/forum/viewtopic.php?f=8&t=3116&sid=a55726840256effd898e67a43fb462c0. This will give a thorough exposition to standard and some advanced occupancy models (e.g., occupancy models for communities) and present both Bayesian (BUGS) and unbayesian (unmarked) analysis of these models.

Kind regards  --  Marc
